rows.title: Introduction
rows.titleText:
Hello there! Welcome to my version of an MLP:FIM NSFW CYOA! Now, who am I, exactly? Well, I can tell you who I'm not: That fucking Chaos Dragon-thing that dares call himself the "Spirit Of Chaos". Seriously, the amount of times I've seen him be used as the resident ROB to send someone from their world to Equestria would make your head spin. If you're expecting him to show up anytime soon, don't. I'm keeping him as far away from this as possible.

But that's all besides the point. This is about you. Now, heads up, I didn't exactly pay attention when I was grabbing your soul. I just kind of grabbed someone who seemed like they could use a vacation from whatever world you're originally from. Maybe you were about to die and I saved your ass, maybe you were just walking down a street, or hell maybe you were doing something I can't even know about. Point is, you're here now, and you're going to a land of Friendship, Magic, and Pastel Colored Tiny Horses!

...That happens to be lewder than usual. What? Did you think I was just gonna drop you into the main version of Equestria? Cause I can, but wouldn't that be boring? Anyway, a couple of rules before we begin:

  1. This whole thing is going to NSFW. If the cover image didn't tip you off, there's gonna be a lot of adult stuff going forward. So if you're not into that, or you shouldn't be seeing this for one reason or another, I'd suggest you navigate yourself away from here. For both our sakes.

  2. While I will be trying to appeal to some fetishes, I am very vanilla and straight. So, if the choices/writings going forward sound made for people like that, that's why. And don't expect fetishes that I see as too extreme. Just warning you now.

  3. For those of you who want to think too hard about things like that, this is a full isekai/reincarnation for the sake of "Narrative" and shit. So, when you get to the vote to decide how things look, note that it's not a "filter". It's how the actual world looks.

I'd suggest you start with the World Section of the CYOA, to create the world you want to go to before creating yourself. But if you want to start with yourself and work your way back, you can do that, too. With that out of the way, let's start! Hope you have fun!

rows.title: World Section
rows.titleText:
Welcome to the World Section of this CYOA! If the title didn't give it away, here you're going to decide some of the details in regards to the version of Equestria you're going to. Now, of course, you're not going to be deciding every little detail, otherwise we'd be here all day. But you're going to be deciding some of the broader aspects of the world. Ones that decide generalities and maybe a little bit of details depending on which one it is. To describe each option here:

World State: The current state of the world.

Population: Current Numbers, Cultures, and otherwise of the world.

Lewdness: How Lewd this world is.

Power Levels: How strong the ponies and general characters in this Setting are/Scale to.

Power Of Friendship/Love: How important/powerful Friendship and Love are and whether or not they're limited to platonic relationships.

Tone: The tone of the world and how Grim or Bright it is.

Other: Stuff that's strange, doesn't fit in, or otherwise doesn't mesh with the rest of this section. Includes extra Fetishes, Genderbending, etc.

objects.title: Peaceful
objects.text:
This is very close to Canon, but perhaps even more so. The world is very peaceful. There's very little conflict, everyone gets along, and the few villains that existed in the show don't exist anymore. Or if they do, they're little more than nuisances rather than actual threats.

https://www.pinterest.com/pin/15340454975683651/

objects.title: Adventure
objects.text:
Also kind of close to Canon. The world is peaceful, but there's still dangerous things out there. You need to be careful where you trot or else you'll get into a world of trouble. But, perhaps, trouble is exactly what you're after? If so, pick this option!

https://www.pinterest.com/pin/AcvM4IeVYsJjzlx5_Db58RRKM_CQB14e-mKrUJtyLBghwS11vAEVaQY/

objects.title: War
objects.text:
The world of Equestria is in a state of war. Perhaps it's a much more non-violent one in comparison to human ones, but it's war. Factions fight each other for their own reasons, and you'll need to make some hard decisions going forward.

https://www.pinterest.com/pin/83949980541678763/

objects.title: Post-Apocalypse
objects.text:
The world of Equestria has been destroyed. Somehow, someway, something destroyed everything that was and now all that's left is the pieces. And those trying to pick them up. Can you even find peace here? Maybe. Who knows?

https://www.pinterest.com/pin/14073817578811747/

objects.title: Before Princesses

https://www.pinterest.com/pin/16114511160901474/

https://e621.net/posts/5763683?q=princess_celestia_%28mlp%29+princess_luna_%28mlp%29

objects.title: Nightmare Moon's Rebellion

Things are no longer good. Luna has been taken over by separate personality that is much more violent, aggressive, and doesn't like to share. She's currently fighting Celestia for dominance and things are getting dire.

https://e621.net/posts/5410978?q=nightmare_moon_%28mlp%29

objects.title: Before Alicorn Twilight

Here, magic doesn't exist (well...it kind of does), and there's an High School that Twilight and her friends go to. Equestria High. I hope you like 2010s High School Cartoon Hi-Jinks.

In this world, the Elements of Harmony are represented by Ponies, but they are corrupted into horrible versions of themselves. Raiders are all over, Mutant Changelings adapt to attacks, and in general shit just straight up sucks. Hope you know what you're doing.

Whether this is really a way to save them is up to who you ask.

rows.title: Power Levels
rows.titleText:
In the show, it's hard to really parse how "powerful" the various characters are. This is done on purpose because...well...it's a kid's show. The focus is more on entertainment than being internally consistent all the time. Celestia and Luna can move the fucking Sun and Moon around, but constantly get punked by beings who should be weaker than them. Twilight is supposedly an extremely powerful and talented Alicorn Princess, but somehow isn't as strong as Starlight Glimmer when they first meet.

This section is about deciding both how powerful the characters actually are and how powerful they can be. If you want to have a basic Power Level/Scale for your Equestria, just pick one option. If you want it to run the gamut and have the possibility of characters growing more powerful if they try, then pick multiple options. If you do pick multiple options, then the world will have a mixture of different potential power levels. For instance, choosing High Power and Shonen Anime means that most ponies can use DND style spells, but only a few can reach DBZ levels of power.

objects.title: Noblebright
objects.text:
The technically Canon version of Equestria. There's barely any really bad things in the world. Most races live together in harmony without any issues, good guys are all over the place and tend to be in charge, most creatures act in the interests of others rather than themselves, and there's plenty of ways to heal even the worst of ailments. While there are bad guys and bad things out there, they're few and far between. And those that aren't are easily dealt with by applying some friendship to the problem.

https://www.pinterest.com/pin/52565520642153744/

objects.title: Nobledark
objects.text:
Equestria still has good creatures in it, but the more unsavory parts of the world have reared their ugly heads. Chrysalis and the Changelings are bigger threats than in Canon, regularly using their powers to infiltrate and cause trouble in societies. While Sombra may not have control over the Crystal Empire, he's still building a force of mind controlled ponies with plans to take over the world. The Everfree Forest is much more dangerous, with more monsters willing to kill and eat ponies. Dangers abound but those who live in Equestria are good people.

https://www.pinterest.com/pin/237072367881692197/

objects.title: Grimbright
objects.text:
While the world of Equestria is a great one, the creatures who live in it aren't necessarily. Celestia and Luna have secrets that they'd rather keep hidden. Their kind smiles hide cruel minds sharpened by thousands of years of rulership. Other races are more willing to try to take advantage of the ponies kindness and cause problems for them, only stopped by Celestia and Luna's politicking. While friendship is magic, it is not able to solve all issues. There's plenty more ponies like Tempest out there in this world. The world is a bright and happy one, but beneath it there is a rot amongst its inhabitants.

https://www.pinterest.com/pin/4855512094550026/

objects.title: Grimdark
objects.text:
The worst version of Equestria. Things are far, far more harsh and evil than they normally are. Chrysalis has an entire empire that is taking over the world, the Sirens are back and have mind controlled the Hippogryphs, Sombra is marching to war, ponies act more like assholes, Celestia and Luna are beginning to turn into Daybreaker and Nightmare Moon, and in general everything is just so much worse. I don't know why you'd want to live in a world like this, but hey. You do you.

https://www.pinterest.com/pin/180566266305086916/

rows.title: Tone
rows.titleText:
What's going to be the tone for your setting? Is it a bright one? A dark one? Something in between?

As a note, if in World State you chose a type of world that would naturally be "Dark" or "Bright", but choose a different Tone here, then this Tone will be less about how the world IS and more how it CAN BE/CAN BE MADE. To put it another way, if you chose Fallout: Equestria and pick to keep it as "Grimdark" then the setting will remain the same as it is in Canon, with you not really be able to change much. You'll be able to obtain SOME victories and happiness, but nothing that could completely change the world and tone without great effort. On the other hand, if you choose "Noblebright" then while the setting will remain the same when you arrive, you'll be able to change it so that it becomes much happier and more hopeful. Characters will be nicer and more likely to choose the "good" options. Bad guys have higher chances of being defeated permanently. And making better civilizations will be a possibility. It'll still take a lot of effort, but it is now possible.

To explain these terms for those that don't know:

Noble/Grim asks if anyone can make lasting changes on the world. In a Noble world, while characters aren't necessarily good, they are active and trying to change the world. And their efforts do bear fruit, for good and for ill. In a Grim world, nothing any singular person does can change the world. The best you can hope for is an individual victory.

Bright/Dark asks about the current state of things. What the world is like and what's out there. A Bright world is full of opportunity, wonder, and reasons to go out there and adventure. Yeah there's danger, but there's usually something to mitigate it. Maybe the reward is so great that it's worth risking lives for. Maybe healing magic is readily available so injuries aren't that bad. Or maybe resurrecting the dead is common practice. Either way, adventuring into the world is worthwhile and something people do. A Dark world is one where the risks are hardly ever worth the reward. There's hardly anything of worth out there to go looking for. What is out there is more likely to kill you rather than help you. If you get injured, it's an actual injury that could kill you and healing isn't readily available. Resurrection is either non-existent or very rare. Basically, the world is bad and most people don't see a reason to try exploring it.

rows.title: Body Types
rows.titleText:
What do the races of Eques look like in this version of the world? Your choice here will apply to every race in the setting, save for pure monsters like the Tiberwolves and such. When you're making your own character, you don't have to have the same Body Type that you choose here, but note that not having one may make you stand out.

You may choose as many Body Types as you wish. If you pick multiple, then a certain portion of the world's population will be given a body type, while the others will be given the other options.

EX: I choose Feral and Anthro. 50% of the world will be Feral and the other 50% will be Anthro. As a note, the world will adjust to fit any body types that are chosen.

objects.title: Default
objects.text:
The default choice. Males and Females are balanced in terms of population. There are enough stallions and mares to ensure that the various races on the planet continue to reproduce and thrive. No issues with who's in charge.

Societies will likely stop seeing men as replaceable since they kind of aren't anymore. Harems will be encouraged, so a single man can spread his seed far and wide to keep the species alive. Though there will also be groups of women who see men as breeding stock and treat them as such. Being a man in this setting could cause you issues or be the best thing that's ever happened to you. rows.title: Tech Level
rows.titleText:
What's the technology of this version of Equestria like? In general, the Canon version seems to be a kind of...kitchen sink/magi-tech/technologically locked world. It's a world where they have trains, electricity, power tools, and other such vehicles. But they don't have any factories, don't have the internet, and haven't gone beyond using swords and shields for combat. Granted, they do have magic, which may explain their general reason for being the way they are...

...but that doesn't explain some of the other stuff like the STORM KING'S FUCKING FLEET OF AIRSHIPS!?

But, whatever, that's neither here nor there. Point is, you can decide how the technology will work for Equestria going forward. You can pick as many as you want. If you do then, once you get here, Equestria will be in whatever the earliest tech level is, and will gradually advance to the highest tech level. Then it will usually stay there until something happens to change things. If you only pick one, then it will be "Locked" to that Tech Level for the rest of your stay.

rows.title: Breeding/Pregnancy
rows.titleText:
How does Breeding and Pregnancy work within this version of Equestria? Not much to really say about this. You know what this is, so let's move on.

Breeding: Who/What can breed with each other?

Pregnancy: How does pregnancy work in this setting?

Hybrids: Are Hybrids possible?

Heat/Estrus/Rut: How does Heat work in this setting?

rows.title: Breeding
rows.titleText: When it comes to making babies, who can make babies with each other? Is there any interspecies interaction, or is it locked to the same species? This will also determine if one group is sexually interested in another.

objects.title: Same Species Only
objects.text:
Only two creatures of the same Species can reproduce. Ponies can only reproduce with ponies, dragons can only reproduce with dragons, etc. etc. There is little sexual interest in other species, and any couples will be purely for pleasure.

https://e621.net/posts/5832190?q=my_little_pony+impregnation

objects.title: Close Enough
objects.text:
If two creatures are close enough in terms of biology, then they can reproduce. Ponies can reproduce with Zebras and Changelings, Dragons could reproduce with other lizard-like races, etc. etc. There's more sexual interest between similar species, and there might even be couples.

https://e621.net/posts/4312712?q=my_little_pony+gryphon+impregnation

objects.title: Open The Gates
objects.text:
Any and all species can reproduce with any other species. Diamond Dogs can reproduce with dragons, Ponies can reproduce with Griffons, etc. etc. Everyone can be interested in anyone, and couples can be extremely varied.

https://e621.net/posts/1442437?q=my_little_pony+gryphon+zebra+impregnation

rows.title: Hybrids
rows.titleText: If it is possible for different species to reproduce, what will their offspring look like? Will they be special, or just have the appearance? If your world can't allow for this, you may skip this part.

objects.title: No Hybrids
objects.text:
There's no chance of hybrids. Any offspring will just have a 50/50 chance of being like one parent or the other.

https://www.deviantart.com/luckreza8/art/Mlp-Fim-Flurry-Heart-happy-vector-681082888

objects.title: His Eyes
objects.text:
Hybrids exist and they draw much of their traits from their father's side. Most Hybrids will be the same species as the father, while taking certain traits from the mother (A Gryphon with the same fur color as his Pony mom).

https://e621.net/posts/5701897?q=my_little_pony+hybrid

objects.title: Like Mom
objects.text:
Hybrids exist and they draw much of their traits from their mother's side. Most Hybrids will be the same species as the mother, while taking certain traits from the father (A Gryphon with the same fur color as her Pony father).

https://e621.net/posts/5864669?q=my_little_pony+hybrid

objects.title: 50/50
objects.text:
Hybrids have a 50/50 chance of being either the same species as the father or mother. They have the same chance of taking traits from either parent.

https://e621.net/posts/5697713?q=my_little_pony+hybrid

objects.title: Rarity
objects.text:
If you'd like, you can pick this option to decide how rare hyrbids are in your world. If this choice isn't picked, then two parents have at least a 33% chance of birthing a hybrid when they get together at base.

https://e621.net/posts/5666186?q=my_little_pony+hybrid

objects.title: No Powers
objects.text:
Any Hybrids don't get any special powers from their bloodlines. Save for those of their species. An Earth Pony born of a Changeling and a Pony will still have their affinity for earth, but won't be able to shift their body in anyway.

https://e621.net/posts/5479841?q=my_little_pony+hybrid

objects.title: One or the Other
objects.text:
Hybrids get powers from one parent but not the other. The offspring of a dragon and a Gryphon might have a Gryphon's capability for flight and claws, but not necessarily a dragon's fire breath. This could cause issues as Hybrids lose out on the best of both worlds, but most will find their own place.

https://e621.net/posts/5485019?q=my_little_pony+hybrid

objects.title: Lucky Duckies
objects.text:
Hybrids get the best of both worlds when it comes to their parents. The child of an Alicorn and a Changelings will be a Changeling Alicorn with all the powers of both species. Due to this, Hybrids may be seen as particularly powerful and special within the world.

https://e621.net/posts/5562036?q=my_little_pony+hybrid

rows.title: Creature Pass
rows.titleText:
So, the vast majority of these options are assumed to be applied to every species in Eques. From Minotaurs, to Changelings, to Dragons, to even the Timberwolves. Nothing is spared from this CYOA...until now. I am aware that not everyone will like the idea of different species being changed based on what is chosen here. So, if there's any Species that you want to be exempt from your choices made here, pick them. They will remain the same as they are in Canon, though they will treat any changes made as normal for the world. Griffons will not bat an eye if they see that Ponies are Anthros. They'll have just been that way since the beginning.

Once you choose a race, just set down what parts of the CYOA they're exempt from. Want Minotaurs to have Heat but not be Anthros? Done. Just fanwank it however you want.

rows.title: New Races
rows.titleText:
Feel like all the races already in MLP aren't enough? Want to include some stuff that's really crazy? This parts for you.

As a note: Any race that's chosen here will be brought up to/brought down to/capped at whatever Tech Level you choose for the setting. To keep things equal. So, even if the race is supposed to be a Space Faring one, they will be brought down to the level of the Eques Tech Level. Though they'll retain any Biological Powers unless otherwise stated.

Arrival Time: When did the New Races arrive in Eques? How long have they been here before you showed up?

Powers: Do any of the races, if they have powers, get to keep them?

Races: What are the new Races showing up on Eques?

rows.title: Arrival Time
rows.titleText: At what point did these new races arrive on Eques? This is going to be in relation to when you arrived/were born into this setting. The longer they've been here, the more time they've had to acclimatize to the world itself. If they've been here for a long time, then they're likely a normal thing. If they have not, then they might be causing friction. Note that the following option applies to ALL the races. Choose one.

objects.title: Since the Beginning
objects.text: These new races have been here since the first new race appeared on Eques. They're just as old as the ponies or any of the other races, and have already found their niche in this world. Most of the other races know of them, and have their own thoughts and feelings regarding them. By the time you show up, they're a normal occurrance.

objects.title: Same Time
objects.text: The new races arrive at the same time you do. If you drop in, then they drop in across the world with you. If you're born/reincarnated into this world, then they show up just after the day you're born/reincarnated. They'll be completely shocked and be ready to shake up the status quo of the planet. For better and worse.

objects.title: A Little Bit Before
objects.text: The new races will show up about 5 to 10 years before you do. Not long enough for everyone to get used to them, but long enough for them to kind of establish themselves. They've got a few outpost here and there, and have already encountered the locals.

objects.title: A Little Bit After
objects.text: The new races will appear about 5 to 10 years after you do. You'll have time to acclimatize to your new life before these guys show up to give it a shake up.

objects.title: Random!
objects.text: There's no timeline to the new races showing up. They'll appear whenever the fuck they want. Maybe they showed up before you, maybe they show up after you, or hell maybe they show up just when you do! It's all down to the winds of chance!

rows.title: Powers
rows.titleText: You are not doubt going to include races that have their own special powers. Most races will have their tech equalized to the setting, but if they have biological or spiritual powers, those won't be touched. Unless you want them to be. So, what do you think? Should the races that come here have their powers? Or would you rather they not? If you choose more than one, then the new races will fall somewhere along your choices on an individual basis. So, if the new race has magic and you choose "No Powers, Equalized, and Full Power" then that means some individuals don't have their powers, some have them but equal to the Eques races, and others have their full strength.

objects.title: No Powers
objects.text: The races that come here won't have any of their biological or spiritual powers. They will only have whatever is natural but not special for them. They're starting at the same level as everyone else.

objects.title: Weakened
objects.text: The races that come here will have their powers, but they'll be weakened to just below the Power Level for the races of Eques. Not to say that they can't get stronger, but they won't have a head start if they normally would.

objects.title: Equalized
objects.text: The power of the new races will be equalized to the Power Level chosen by you. If this Eques has a Low Magic Power Level, then the new races will have their powers diminished/enhanced until they equal that. If this Eques has Shonen Power Levels, then the new Races will be diminished/enhanced to meet that level.

objects.title: Full Power
objects.text: The powers of the new races aren't affected in the slightest. They have whatever biological or spiritual powers they had from their home universe, without any changes whatsoever. Hopefully, they don't do something mad with it.

rows.title: Races
rows.titleText: What you were waiting for. What new races will you bring to Eques?

objects.title: Humans
objects.text:
The standard option that I knew you would pick. You're bringing humans into Eques. I hope I don't need to tell you what a human is.

https://e621.net/posts/5799085?q=my_little_pony+human

objects.title: Digimon
objects.text:
Digital Monsters! Despite being...well...Digital, Digimon are also physical begins that can exist without the internet. They have special powers and can evolve based on their bonds with their "Tamers". Their evolution is powerful with each stage (Rookie, Champion, Ultimate, Mega) increasing exponentially, with every Digimon able to turn into almost any other Digimon with the right stimulus. Though they are also effected by negative emotions, so you'd better hope that they get good Tamers.

https://e621.net/posts/3053387?q=my_little_pony+digimon

objects.title: Pokemon
objects.text:
More natural than Digimon, Pokemon are more akin to intelligent animals than anything else. There are over a hundred of them, and each one has their own special powers and abilities. They too draw strength from their Trainers, but their evolution is more Linear in terms of power and progression.

https://e621.net/posts/5623862?q=my_little_pony+pokemon_%28species%29

objects.title: The Broken Lords
objects.text:
Once a proud race of Knights, the Broken Lords lost their physical forms and now are little more than floating, sentient Dust in armor. However, this Dust is actually a cloud of nanomachines that can allow for incredible creations and miracles. Since Dust flows in all things, the Lords have discovered a way to create more of themselves and keep themselves alive: Draining the Dust from others. Which can kill them. They are meant to be noble knights, but can they keep to their code in such a horrid state?

https://community.amplitude-studios.com/amplitude-studios/endless-legend-2/blogs/976-last-lords-spotlight

objects.title: Caribou
objects.text:
A species of deer who's primary distinction is that both the males and females grow antlers. They also tend to be bigger and stronger than others of their species. A specific variant are the primary antagonist of a certain version of Equestria, but these are not those kind of Caribou. Unless you want them to be but that's for later...

https://e621.net/posts/4635897?q=my_little_pony+reindeer

objects.title: Deer
objects.text:
Quadrapedal creatures that are smaller and more skittish than horses. Female does don't grow antlers, but male bucks do. Tend to bounce and hop around rather than gallop or run. Very skittish.

https://e621.net/posts/4635897?q=my_little_pony+reindeer

objects.title: Tieflings
objects.text:
A race of creatures born of devils and demons from the Forgotten Realms setting. All Tieflings have horns, tales, brightly colored skin, and have different special abilities based on their lineage. They also have a tendency to be either edgelords or really horny. But these don't have to be.

https://www.deviantart.com/cosmalumi/art/Pony-Meets-Nonpony-1006259649

objects.title: Transformers
objects.text:
ROBOTS IN DISGUISE! The Transformers are a race of living machines that come from the living planet Cybertron. They are able to scan mechanical vehicles and shift their bodies to "transform" into them. Their race split into two groups, Autobots and Decepticons, and the two have been at war for eons. Where one group goes, you can be sure the others will follow.

https://e621.net/posts/3613051?q=my_little_pony+transformers

objects.title: Orcs
objects.text:
A race of barbaric, green-skinned, roving monsters. Orcs have been known to create tribes that go around and raid other villages for food, women, men, and whatever else they want. They're also a rather aggressively horny race, with a savage warrior culture that usually follows "Might makes Right".

https://gelbooru.com/index.php?page=post&s=view&id=12320181&tags=orc+warrior+

objects.title: Orks
objects.text:
Different in many ways. For one, their name has a "K" not a "C". For another, they're not born through sex because they're mushrooms. It is almost impossible to get rid of Orks as they always survive thanks to the spores they leave behind. They care about two things "Fighin' and Winnin'", with massive WAAAGGGGHHHSSS! Being created when one Ork (called a Warboss) gathers together a bunch of tribes to go find big fights. Also, the tougher an Ork is, the bigger he becomes.

They don't actually have any real females, but you can include them if you wish.

defaultRowText: This is a row, and inside of it, you can place choices. On both rows and choices Requirements can be placed, which will block a row from being viewed, or make the player unable to select a choice, depending on either Point-types or the Ids of other choices. Point-types can be made in Features then Manage Points. Hovering over buttons will explain what they do. The Design of the project can be changed in 'Modify Design' at the side navigation bar, and private styling for each row can be turned on in the rows Settings. Default text like this can be turned off in Features -> Manage Defaults.
defaultChoiceText: This is a Choice, and inside of it, you can place images and text. Scores can be added to it, and have Point-types attached. Addons can be added underneath the image and text. In the Functions at the bottom of the choice, there is an array of different things that can be done. Default text like this can be turned off in Features then Manage Defaults.
